Six food pans with lids. Six dishes in one counter let you offer a full menu at once, and the lids keep heat in and flies out.

Gentle bain marie heat. Water heats the pans gently, so food stays hot without sticking, drying or burning, even over long service.

Stainless steel body. The unit resists rust and spills and wipes clean at the end of the day.

Stand with undershelf. The stand holds the counter at a comfortable serving height and the shelf stores spare pans and plates.

Easy to serve. Staff can reach every pan, so serving is quick and customers do not wait.

sections.heading: Who It Suits
sections.body: Hotels and restaurants, school and staff canteens, hospitals, catering businesses and buffet lines.

sections.heading: What to Check Before Buying
sections.body: Confirm whether you need an electric or gas model, and place it close to your power or gas supply. Tell us how many dishes you serve so we can recommend the number of pans.

sections.heading: Care and Maintenance
sections.body: Empty and clean pans after service, let the water cool before draining and wipe the body with warm soapy water. Keep controls dry.

sections.heading: In Practice
sections.body: Switch the bain marie on early, fill it with the right amount of water and let it heat before you put in the food. Keep lids on between servings, top up the water as it evaporates and stir the food occasionally. At the end of service, empty the water when it is cool and wash the pans.

sections.heading: What Kenyan Buyers Look For
sections.body:
Hotels, canteens and caterers in Kenya search for an electric food warmer, often with the words buffet food warmer, when they need to keep cooked food hot during service. Buyers compare the number of pans, whether the unit is electric, and whether it stands on wheels or a frame. Stainless steel is the choice because it wipes clean and keeps its looks.

Searches for a bain marie food warmer come from restaurants, hotels, schools and small businesses alike, and we serve all of them with the same care.

sections.heading: Fit It to Your Space
sections.body: Ask us for adjustments before you order. Lengths, heights, shelf positions and fittings can often be changed to suit your workflow, and we will explain the options in plain language.

faqs.q: Where can I buy a bain marie counter in Kenya?
faqs.a: Kitchen And All sells it online at kitchenandall.co.ke, and our team is ready to advise you on the right option. We deliver free within Nairobi and quickly countrywide with shipping charges.

faqs.q: How much is a bain marie in Kenya?
faqs.a: Price depends on the number of pans, whether it is an open table or a cabinet, the wheels and the heating, so the figure on this page is for the model shown. For a different size or finish, message us on WhatsApp and we will quote clearly.

faqs.q: Does a bain marie cook food?
faqs.a: No. It keeps cooked food hot for serving. Cook the food first, then hold it in the pans.

faqs.q: Is it electric or gas?
faqs.a: Please confirm with our team when you order. We will state clearly which heating the unit has.

faqs.q: How long does it keep food hot?
faqs.a: A bain marie keeps food at serving temperature for as long as it stays switched on and topped up with water.

faqs.q: Can I get a smaller or bigger one?
faqs.a: Yes, we supply bain maries with different numbers of pans.
